hero.title: How SolarMatch Works
hero.subtitle: Our engineering-grade calculator uses real NASA climate data and Egypt's actual electricity tariffs to give you accurate solar feasibility estimates

location.title: Select Your Location
location.description: Click on the map or use GPS to pinpoint your building's location in Egypt
location.details: We use your coordinates to fetch location-specific solar irradiance data from NASA's POWER API

configure.title: Configure Your System
configure.description: Enter your rooftop area, building type, and choose a panel package
configure.details: Select from economy, standard, or premium panels with different efficiency ratings and costs

calculate.title: Run the Calculation
calculate.description: Our 11-step engineering model calculates your solar potential
calculate.details: We factor in usable roof space, panel efficiency, local climate, and Egypt's 7-tier electricity tariffs

results.title: Get Your Report
results.description: View detailed results including energy production, savings, and ROI timeline
results.details: Download a PDF report, share your results, or contact a solar expert for next steps

irradiance.title: Solar Irradiance Data
irradiance.description: We use NASA POWER API data for Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI) specific to your location, measured in kWh/m²/day

yield.title: Specific Yield Calculation
yield.description: Egypt-optimized yield of 1,800 kWh/kWp/year accounts for panel orientation, temperature effects, and system losses

roi.title: 25-Year ROI Projections
roi.description: Financial modeling includes 0.5% annual panel degradation, optional electricity inflation, and Egypt's actual tariff structure

carbon.title: Carbon Footprint Reduction
carbon.description: CO₂ savings calculated using Egypt's grid emission factor of 0.55 kg CO₂/kWh based on the national energy mix

dataSources.title: Our Data Sources
dataSources.description: SolarMatch relies on authoritative, up-to-date data sources to ensure accuracy:
dataSources.nasa: NASA POWER API - 40+ years of satellite-derived solar radiation data
dataSources.tariffs: Egypt Electricity Holding Company - Official 2024/2025 residential tariff rates
dataSources.panels: Industry-standard panel specifications from leading manufacturers

hero.title: About SolarMatch
hero.subtitle: Empowering Egypt's transition to sustainable solar energy through accessible, accurate feasibility analysis

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: SolarMatch aims to democratize solar feasibility analysis for Egyptian homeowners and businesses. We believe that accurate information is the first step toward sustainable energy adoption, and we're committed to making that information accessible to everyone.

background.title: Project Background
background.p1: SolarMatch was developed as a professional demonstration for a student innovation competition focused on sustainable technology solutions for the Egyptian market.
background.p2: Egypt has exceptional solar potential, with average daily irradiance exceeding 5.5 kWh/m² across most of the country. However, many property owners lack access to reliable tools for evaluating whether solar makes sense for their specific situation.
background.p3: Our platform bridges this gap by combining real NASA climate data with Egypt's actual electricity tariff structure to provide engineering-grade feasibility assessments that anyone can understand.

accuracy.title: Scientific Accuracy
accuracy.description: We use peer-reviewed methodologies and authoritative data sources to ensure our calculations reflect real-world performance

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Complex engineering calculations presented in a simple, intuitive interface that anyone can use without technical expertise

localization.title: Egypt-First Design
localization.description: Built specifically for the Egyptian market with local tariffs, Arabic language support, and region-appropriate assumptions

education.title: Educational Impact
education.description: Beyond calculations, we aim to educate users about solar technology and its benefits for household economics and the environment

features.realtime: Real-time NASA climate data for any Egyptian location
features.ai: AI-powered solar advisor for personalized recommendations

impact.title: Environmental Impact
impact.description: Every solar installation reduces dependence on fossil fuels and lowers carbon emissions. By helping more Egyptians understand their solar potential, we contribute to the country's renewable energy goals and a cleaner future for coming generations.
